questions.questionText: DDL का पूर्ण रूप है-
questions.questionTextEn: What is the full form of DDL?
questions.explanation: DDL stands for Data Definition Language. It is used to define and manage the structure of the database such as CREATE, ALTER, DROP, TRUNCATE commands.

questions.questionText: कौनसी कमाण्ड SQL में टेबल के कॉलम की redefine करने के लिए प्रयोग की जाती है?
questions.questionTextEn: Which command is used in SQL to redefine a column of a table?
questions.explanation: ALTER TABLE command is used in SQL to modify the structure of an existing table — including adding, deleting, or redefining (modifying) columns.

questions.questionText: इण्टी के प्राप्त Primary Key (प्राइमरी 'की') क्या कहलाती है?
questions.questionTextEn: What is the derived/obtained Primary Key of an entity called?
questions.explanation: An entity that has its own Primary Key is called a Strong Entity. The primary key itself uniquely identifies each record/tuple in a table.

questions.questionText: इनमें से कौनसा Database का Element नहीं है?
questions.questionTextEn: Which of the following is NOT an element of a database?
questions.explanation: In MS Access database context, the main elements/objects are Tables, Queries, Forms, Reports, Macros, and Modules. A Tuple is a row/record inside a table — it is part of relational theory terminology, not a standalone database object/element.

questions.questionText: निम्न में से कौनसा DBMS सॉफ्टवेयर नहीं है?
questions.questionTextEn: Which of the following is NOT a DBMS software?
questions.explanation: DBASE, FoxPro, and Oracle are all real DBMS software. 'DATABASE 2000' is not a real DBMS product. Note: IBM's DB2 exists but 'DATABASE 2000' is fictitious.

questions.questionText: समय-समय पर, किसी फाइल में डाटा को जोड़ना, डाटा को बदलना तथा डाटा को मिटाना, फाइल का ___ कहलाता है?
questions.questionTextEn: Adding data to a file, changing data, and deleting data from time to time is called ___ of the file?
questions.explanation: File maintenance includes adding, modifying, and deleting records — collectively called Updation (file updating). This is a core database operation.

questions.questionText: सेट (Set) कान्सेप्ट कहाँ इस्तेमाल किया जाता है?
questions.questionTextEn: Where is the Set concept used?
questions.explanation: In the Relational Model, data is organized as sets of tuples (rows). Relations (tables) are based on the mathematical concept of sets. Set theory is the foundation of relational databases.

questions.questionText: किसी सारणी में केवल एक ___ हो सकती है?
questions.questionTextEn: A table can have only one ___?
questions.explanation: A table can have only ONE Primary Key (though it can be composite). However, a table can have multiple Candidate Keys and multiple Alternate Keys. The one selected as primary is the Primary Key.

questions.questionText: DML क्या है?
questions.questionTextEn: What is DML?
questions.explanation: DML stands for Data Manipulation Language. It includes SQL commands like SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE that manipulate data within tables.

questions.questionText: इनमें से किस कुंजी (Key) के जरिए किसी सारणी में किसी पंक्ति को खोजा जा सकता है?
questions.questionTextEn: Which key can be used to search/find a particular row in a table?
questions.explanation: All three key types — Primary Key, Alternate Key, and Candidate Key — can uniquely identify a row in a table. All candidate keys have the property of unique row identification.

questions.questionText: डेटाबेस में एट्रिब्यूट क्या होता है?
questions.questionTextEn: What is an Attribute in a database?
questions.explanation: In database terminology, an Attribute corresponds to a Column (field) in a table. It represents a property or characteristic of an entity.

questions.questionText: निम्न में से कौन-सा ऑब्जेक्ट प्रिंट आउट के फॉर्मेट में होता है?
questions.questionTextEn: Which of the following database objects is in printout format?
questions.explanation: In MS Access and database systems, a Report is designed specifically for printing data in a formatted, readable layout. Reports are the database objects meant for printout.

questions.questionText: किसी क्वैरी के उत्तर में जो सूचनाएँ या रिकॉर्ड निकाले जाते हैं उसे उस क्वैरी का ..... कहते हैं?
questions.questionTextEn: The information or records retrieved as an answer to a query is called the ___ of that query?
questions.explanation: In MS Access, the result set returned by a query is called a Dynaset. It is a dynamic set of records that reflects the current state of the underlying table data.

questions.questionText: ....... डेटाबेस में डेटा को वृक्ष के रूप में नोड्स के माध्यम से व्यवस्थित किया जाता है?
questions.questionTextEn: In ___ database, data is organized in the form of a tree through nodes?
questions.explanation: In the Hierarchical Database Model, data is organized in a tree-like structure with nodes (parent-child relationships). Each parent can have multiple children but each child has only one parent.

questions.questionText: टेबल के एक स्तम्भ को कहते हैं-
questions.questionTextEn: A single column of a table is called?
questions.explanation: A column in a relational table is called an Attribute (or Field). Each attribute represents a specific property of the entity being stored.

questions.questionText: यह डेटाबेस की लॉजिकल संरचना है-
questions.questionTextEn: This is the logical structure of a database-
questions.explanation: Schema is the logical structure/blueprint of the database. It defines how data is organized — the tables, columns, data types, relationships, constraints. Schema ≠ actual data.

questions.questionText: किसी सिंगल एंटिटी सम्बन्धी डाटा का व्यवस्थित कलेक्शन है-
questions.questionTextEn: An organized collection of data related to a single entity is called?
questions.explanation: A database is an organized, structured collection of related data about entities. It allows efficient storage, retrieval, and management of data.

questions.questionText: निम्न में कौन एक डाटाबेस में एक एकल एंटिटी जैसे कि व्यक्ति, स्थान या वस्तु आदि के बारे में सूचना संग्रहित करता है-
questions.questionTextEn: Which one stores information about a single entity such as a person, place, or object in a database?
questions.explanation: A Record (Row/Tuple) stores all information about a single entity (e.g., one student's complete data). A table stores multiple records.

questions.questionText: एक प्रोग्राम, जिसका इंटरफेस उपयोगकर्ता के लिए DBMS में ज्यादा अनुकूल होता है, क्या कहलाता है?
questions.questionTextEn: A program whose interface is more user-friendly for DBMS is called?
questions.explanation: In database context, a Form provides a user-friendly interface for data entry and viewing. Forms make DBMS interaction more accessible to end users who don't know SQL.

questions.questionText: एक कम्प्यूटर उपयोग करने देने से पहले यूजरनेम और पासवर्ड के ___ की जाँच करता है-
questions.questionTextEn: Before allowing a computer to be used, it checks the ___ of username and password?
questions.explanation: Username and password credentials are stored and verified against a database. The authentication system checks the database to validate login credentials.

questions.questionText: एंटिटी सेट, जिसमें प्राइमरी की बनाने के लिए पर्याप्त फील्ड नहीं होते हैं, क्या कहलाता है?
questions.questionTextEn: An entity set that does not have sufficient fields to form a primary key is called?
questions.explanation: A Weak Entity Set does not have sufficient attributes to form its own primary key. It depends on a Strong Entity for identification and uses a partial key + owner entity's primary key.

questions.questionText: रिलेशनल डाटाबेस में, एक डाटा स्ट्रक्चर जो एक विषय के बारे में सभी सूचनाओं को पंक्तियों तथा स्तम्भ के रूप में व्यवस्थित करता है-
questions.questionTextEn: In relational databases, a data structure that organizes all information about a subject in rows and columns is called?
questions.explanation: In relational databases, a Table (Relation) organizes data in a 2D structure of rows (tuples/records) and columns (attributes/fields). It is the fundamental data structure.

questions.questionText: एक रिकॉर्ड का एक विशेष फील्ड, जो प्रत्येक रिकॉर्ड को विशिष्ट रूप से पहचान दिलाता है-
questions.questionTextEn: A special field of a record that uniquely identifies each record is called?
questions.explanation: A Key Field (Primary Key) is a special field that uniquely identifies each record in a table. No two records can have the same key field value.

questions.questionText: एक डाटा आइटम के संग्रहण के लिए ___ की आवश्यकता होती है?
questions.questionTextEn: For storage of a single data item, ___ is required?
questions.explanation: In the data hierarchy, a Field is the smallest named unit that stores a single data item (e.g., a student's name, age). Database is the top level containing all data.

questions.questionText: IR Diagram में रिलेशनशिप टाइप को .... द्वारा प्रदर्शित किया जाता है?
questions.questionTextEn: In ER Diagram, Relationship Type is represented by?
questions.explanation: In ER Diagrams: Rectangle = Entity, Ellipse = Attribute, Diamond = Relationship, Double Rectangle = Weak Entity, Dashed Ellipse = Derived Attribute.

questions.questionText: कुंजी, जिसका प्रयोग दो सारणियों के बीच सम्बन्ध को प्रदर्शित करने के लिए किया जाता है, कहलाती है-
questions.questionTextEn: The key used to represent a relationship between two tables is called?
questions.explanation: A Foreign Key is an attribute in one table that references the Primary Key of another table, establishing a relationship (link) between the two tables.

questions.questionText: ..... का अर्थ है एक तथ्य को एक से अधिक जगह स्टोर करना-
questions.questionTextEn: _____ means storing a fact in more than one place?
questions.explanation: Data Redundancy means storing the same data in multiple locations. DBMS is designed to minimize redundancy to avoid data inconsistency and wasted storage.

questions.questionText: SQL में डेटाबेस से Table को Remove करने के लिए कमाण्ड का उपयोग किया जाता है?
questions.questionTextEn: Which command is used in SQL to Remove/delete a Table from the database?
questions.explanation: DROP TABLE is the SQL DDL command used to permanently remove a table (structure + data) from the database.

questions.questionText: एक बड़ी कम्प्यूटर सूचना प्रणाली कई अलग-अलग Computer फाइलों को बनाए रखती है। परंतु उनमें से किसे Computer का Original फाइल कहा जाता है?
questions.questionTextEn: A large computer information system maintains many different files. Which of these is called the Original file of the Computer?
questions.explanation: The Master File is the main/permanent/original file that contains the most current and authoritative version of data. Transaction files update the master file.

questions.questionText: निम्नलिखित में से one-to-many relationship के साथ तार्किक डेटा संरचना है?
questions.questionTextEn: Which of the following is a logical data structure with one-to-many relationship?
questions.explanation: A Tree structure supports one-to-many relationships where one parent node can have multiple children but each child has only one parent. This is the basis of the Hierarchical model.

questions.questionText: निम्नलिखित में से क्या होता है जब आप किसी फॉर्म में जानकारी दर्ज करना समाप्त करते हैं?
questions.questionTextEn: What happens when you finish entering information in a form?
options: टेम्पलेट डेटा फाइल में लिखी जाती है
फॉर्म की सामग्री डेटा फाइल में लिखी जाती है
फॉर्म की सामग्री मुद्रित की जा सकती है
optionsEn: Form content is written to data file
questions.explanation: When a form is submitted/completed, the entered data is saved/written to the underlying data file (table). Forms are the interface; data is stored in tables.

questions.questionText: एक सूची में last names, first names, addresses और pin codes होते हैं। यदि सूची में सभी लोगों के पास एक ही अंतिम और एक ही पिन Code होता है, तो कौनसी उपयोगी कुंजी होगी?
questions.questionTextEn: A list has last names, first names, addresses, and pin codes. If everyone in the list has the same last name and same pin code, which would be a useful key?
options: a compound key consisting of the first name and the last name
उपरोक्त सभी / All of the above
questions.explanation: Since all records have the same last name AND same pin code, these alone cannot uniquely identify records. A compound (composite) key of first name + last name would be more unique.

questions.questionText: कई संबंधित रिकॉर्ड को एक इकाई के रूप में माना जाता है जिसे ___ कहते हैं?
questions.questionTextEn: Several related records treated as a unit are called?
questions.explanation: A File is a collection of related records treated as a unit. Data hierarchy: Field → Record → File → Database.

questions.questionText: निम्न में से कौन relational database नहीं है?
questions.questionTextEn: Which of the following is NOT a relational database?
questions.explanation: DBASE IV, 4th Dimension, and FoxPro are relational database systems. Reflex is a flat-file database system, not a relational database.

questions.questionText: ......एक relationship की संरचना को परिभाषित करता है जिसमें विशेषता-डोमेन का एक निश्चित सेट होता है?
questions.questionTextEn: _____ defines the structure of a relationship, with a fixed set of attribute-domains?
questions.explanation: Schema is the structural definition of a database/relation, specifying attribute names, their domains (data types), and constraints.

questions.questionText: एक फॉर्म परिभाषित करता है-
questions.questionTextEn: A form defines?
options: where data is placed on the screen
उपरोक्त सभी / All of the above
questions.explanation: A database form defines both the layout (where data appears on screen) and field properties like width. Forms control the visual representation of data input.

questions.questionText: डेटा संगठन की hierarchy में highest level को क्या कहा जाता है?
questions.questionTextEn: What is the highest level in the data organization hierarchy called?
questions.explanation: Data Hierarchy: Bit → Byte/Character → Field → Record → File → Database. Database is the highest level in this hierarchy.

questions.questionText: ......... खंड एक अतिरिक्त filter है जो परिणाम पर लागू होता है?
questions.questionTextEn: _____ clause is an additional filter applied to the result?
questions.explanation: HAVING clause is used to filter the results of GROUP BY. It's like WHERE but applied AFTER grouping. HAVING = additional filter on grouped results.

questions.questionText: एक Logical Schema ___ है?
questions.questionTextEn: A Logical Schema is?
options: सुलभ भाग में जानकारी व्यवस्थित करने का एक मानक तरीका
वर्णन करता है कि वास्तव में डिस्क पर डेटा कैसे संग्रहीत किया जाता है
optionsEn: A standard way to organize info in accessible part
Describes how data is stored on disk
questions.explanation: Logical Schema defines how the database appears to the users — the logical organization of data (tables, relationships, constraints) independent of physical storage. It's the conceptual/logical level of the 3-schema architecture.

questions.questionText: क्रिएट टेबल में कौनसी कमाण्ड इसके कॉलम एवं इन्टिग्रिटी कन्स्ट्रेंट को परिभाषित करती है?
questions.questionTextEn: Which command in CREATE TABLE defines its columns and integrity constraints?
questions.explanation: The CREATE TABLE command defines the table structure including column names, data types, and integrity constraints (PRIMARY KEY, NOT NULL, UNIQUE, FOREIGN KEY, CHECK).

questions.questionText: Tables के बीच Relations का प्रतिनिधित्व करने की कुंजी को किसे कहा जाता है?
questions.questionTextEn: The key that represents Relations between Tables is called?
questions.explanation: Foreign Key is used to establish and represent the relationship (link) between two tables. It references the Primary Key of another table.

questions.questionText: ___ डीबीएमएस प्राप्त करने में मदद करता है?
questions.questionTextEn: ___ helps in obtaining DBMS?
questions.explanation: ALTER command helps modify existing database objects (tables, columns) to obtain the desired DBMS structure.

questions.questionText: .....डेटाबेस का प्रयोग सभी डेटाबेस के लिए टेम्पलेट बनाने के लिए किया जाता है?
questions.questionTextEn: _____ database is used as a template for creating all databases?
options: इनमें से कोई नहीं / None of these
questions.explanation: In SQL Server, the Model database serves as the template for all new databases. When you create a new database, SQL Server copies the Model database structure.

questions.questionText: DBMS के तहत सीधे अखंडता जांच को केंद्रीकृत करना डुप्लिकेशन और डेटाबेस की स्थिरता और वैधता सुनिश्चित करता है .... करता है?
questions.questionTextEn: Centralizing integrity checks under DBMS _____ duplication and ensures stability and validity of the database?
questions.explanation: DBMS centralizes integrity constraints, which REDUCES data duplication and ensures consistency. This is one of the major advantages of DBMS over file systems.

questions.questionText: DDL statements निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा है?
questions.questionTextEn: Which of the following is a DDL statement?
options: उपर्युक्त सभी / All of the above
questions.explanation: DDL (Data Definition Language) statements include: CREATE, DROP, ALTER, TRUNCATE, RENAME, COMMENT. All three options — create, drop, alter — are DDL statements.

questions.questionText: Snapshot में ___ part ओरेकल बताता है कि रीफ्रेश के बीच कितना इंतजार करना है?
questions.questionTextEn: In Snapshot, the ___ part tells Oracle how long to wait between refreshes?
questions.explanation: In Oracle Snapshots (Materialized Views), the REFRESH clause specifies when and how the snapshot should be refreshed. The interval between refreshes is specified in the REFRESH clause.

questions.questionText: एक पहलू जिसे अखंडता उपप्रणाली द्वारा निपटाया जाना है, यह सुनिश्चित करना है कि प्रत्येक डेटा आइटम को केवल वैध मान assign किए जा सकें। इसे किस रूप में जाना जाता है?
questions.questionTextEn: An aspect handled by the integrity subsystem — ensuring each data item can only be assigned valid values — is known as?
questions.explanation: Domain Integrity ensures that every value in a column belongs to a valid set/range (domain). It enforces valid data types, ranges, and formats for each attribute.

questions.questionText: सिस्टम वैरिएवल $ date $ के लिए निम्न में से कौन-सा सत्य है?
questions.questionTextEn: Which of the following is true for system variable $date$?
options: एक वैश्विक चर को allot किया जा सकता है
केवल डिजाइन समय के दौरान किसी भी क्षेत्र में assign किया जा सकता है
रन समय के दौरान किसी भी चर या क्षेत्र को allot किया जा सकता है
एक स्थानीय चर के लिए allot किया जा सकता है
optionsEn: Can be allotted to a global variable
Can only be assigned during design time
Can be allotted to any variable at runtime
Can be allotted to a local variable
questions.explanation: The system variable $date$ (in 4D/database systems) can only be assigned to fields during design time, not at runtime.

questions.questionText: ___ ऑपरेटर मूल रूप से पहले relation के गुणों पर एक परियोजना के बाद एक जुड़ाव है?
questions.questionTextEn: ___ operator is essentially a join followed by a project on the attributes of the first relation?
questions.explanation: Semi-join is a join followed by a projection on the attributes of the first relation. It returns only the rows from the first relation that have matching rows in the second relation.

questions.questionText: डेटाबेस प्रबंधन प्रणाली के संचालन के लिए निम्न में से कौनसा हार्डवेयर घटक सबसे महत्वपूर्ण है?
questions.questionTextEn: Which hardware component is most important for the operation of a DBMS?
questions.explanation: A high-speed, large-capacity disk (storage) is the most critical hardware for DBMS as databases store massive amounts of data that must be accessed quickly from secondary storage.

questions.questionText: कौन-सी प्रॉपर्टी किसी तालिका की विशेषता को एकाधिक मानों में नहीं रख सकती है?
questions.questionTextEn: Which property does NOT allow an attribute of a table to hold multiple values?
questions.explanation: 1NF (First Normal Form) requires that all attributes contain ATOMIC (single) values — no multi-valued attributes or repeating groups are allowed.

questions.questionText: एक करके स्ट्रिंग के निर्दिष्ट हिस्से को वापस करने के लिए कौनसा करेक्टर फंक्शन उपयोग किया जा सकता है?
questions.questionTextEn: Which character function can be used to return a specified part of a string?
questions.explanation: SUBSTR (or SUBSTRING) extracts a specified portion of a string. SUBSTR(string, start, length) returns the substring. INSTR finds the position of a substring.

questions.questionText: ट्रिगर्स में विभिन्न घटनाएं कौन-सी है?
questions.questionTextEn: Which of the following are events in Triggers?
questions.explanation: Database triggers fire (execute automatically) on DML events: INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE. These are the three events that can activate a trigger on a table.

questions.questionText: डेटाबेस Table में मौजूदा डेटा को संशोधित करने के लिए निम्न में से कौन-सी SQL कमाण्ड का उपयोग किया जा सकता है?
questions.questionTextEn: Which SQL command can be used to modify existing data in a database table?
questions.explanation: UPDATE is the SQL DML command used to modify existing records in a table. Syntax: UPDATE table SET column=value WHERE condition.

questions.questionText: वह कौन-सी है जिसमें Table में पंक्तियों को विशेष रूप से पहचानने के लिए एक से अधिक गुण होते हैं?
questions.questionTextEn: Which key has more than one attribute to uniquely identify rows in a table?
questions.explanation: A Composite Key consists of more than one attribute (column) combined to uniquely identify rows in a table. No single column is unique enough alone.

questions.questionText: डेटाबेस management दृष्टिकोण का एक फायदा है?
questions.questionTextEn: One advantage of the database management approach is?
options: डेटा एकीकृत है और कई कार्यक्रमों द्वारा पहुंचा जा सकता है
optionsEn: Data is integrated and accessible by many programs
questions.explanation: A major advantage of DBMS is data integration and shared access — data is centralized and can be accessed by multiple programs/users simultaneously, reducing redundancy.

questions.questionText: एक विशेष पल में डेटाबेस में संग्रहित जानकारी का संग्रह के रूप में माना जाता है?
questions.questionTextEn: Information stored in a database at a particular moment is considered as?
questions.explanation: An Instance (or database state/snapshot) is the collection of information stored in a database at a particular moment in time. Schema is the structure; instance is the actual data.

questions.questionText: data Independence का मतलब है?
questions.questionTextEn: Data Independence means?
options: डेटा को अलग से परिभाषित किया गया है और कार्यक्रमों में शामिल नहीं है
प्रोग्राम डेटा के भौतिक विशेषताओं पर निर्भर नहीं है
प्रोग्राम डेटा के तार्किक विशेषताओं पर निर्भर नहीं है
optionsEn: Data is defined separately and not embedded in programs
Programs do not depend on physical characteristics of data
Programs do not depend on logical characteristics of data
questions.explanation: Data Independence has two types: Physical Independence (programs don't depend on physical storage) and Logical Independence (programs don't depend on logical structure changes).

questions.questionText: किसी Table में Column की value बदलने के लिए ......... कमाण्ड का उपयोग किया जा सकता है?
questions.questionTextEn: Which command is used to change the value of a column in a table?
questions.explanation: UPDATE command changes/modifies existing column values in a table. ALTER changes the TABLE STRUCTURE (columns). UPDATE changes DATA VALUES in columns.

questions.questionText: Database Management System में DDL का पूरा रूप है?
questions.questionTextEn: What is the full form of DDL in Database Management System?
questions.explanation: DDL = Data Definition Language. It defines the structure of the database. Key DDL commands: CREATE, ALTER, DROP, TRUNCATE.

questions.questionText: अन्य उपयोगकर्ता को दिए गए विशेषाधिकारों को पारित करने के लिए ......... खंड का उपयोग किया जाता है?
questions.questionTextEn: Which clause is used to pass privileges given to other users?
questions.explanation: GRANT OPTION (WITH GRANT OPTION in SQL) allows a user to pass/transfer the privileges they received to other users. Example: GRANT SELECT ON table TO user WITH GRANT OPTION.

questions.questionText: एक Entity Relationship diagram में 'Double Rectangle' का प्रतिनिधित्व कौन करता है?
questions.questionTextEn: What does a 'Double Rectangle' represent in an Entity Relationship diagram?
questions.explanation: In ER Diagrams: Double Rectangle = Weak Entity Set, Single Rectangle = Strong Entity, Diamond = Relationship, Ellipse = Attribute, Double Ellipse = Multi-valued Attribute, Dashed Ellipse = Derived Attribute.

questions.questionText: डेटाबेस डिजाइनर द्वारा candidate key के सेट से चुनी गई key को किस नाम से बुलाया जाता है?
questions.questionTextEn: The key chosen by the database designer from the set of candidate keys is called?
questions.explanation: From all Candidate Keys (minimal superkeys), the database designer selects ONE as the Primary Key. The rest become Alternate Keys.

questions.questionText: डेटाबेस सिस्टम के रिलेशनल मॉडल के 'CODD Rule' में कितने नियम हैं?
questions.questionTextEn: How many rules are there in Codd's Rules for the Relational Model of database systems?
questions.explanation: Dr. E.F. Codd proposed 12 rules (Rules 0-12, actually 13 total rules with Rule 0) for a fully relational DBMS. The commonly cited count is 12 rules (Rules 1-12).

questions.questionText: Degree of Relationship है?
questions.questionTextEn: Degree of Relationship refers to?
options: रिश्ते में पंक्ति और कॉलम की संख्या
रिश्ते में भाग लेने वाली संस्थाओं की संख्या
optionsEn: Number of tables in the relationship
Number of rows and columns in relationship
Number of entities participating in relationship
questions.explanation: The Degree of a Relationship is the number of entity sets that participate in that relationship. Unary=1, Binary=2, Ternary=3, N-ary=N entities.

questions.questionText: निम्न में से कौन-सा attributes हैं जो किसी भी candidate key का हिस्सा नहीं है?
questions.questionTextEn: Which of the following attributes are NOT part of any candidate key?
questions.explanation: Non-prime attributes are those that do NOT form part of any candidate key. Prime attributes = attributes that are part of at least one candidate key.

questions.questionText: super key का न्यूनतम सेट कहा जाता है?
questions.questionTextEn: The minimum set of a super key is called?
questions.explanation: A Candidate Key is a minimal Super Key — it has the minimum number of attributes needed to uniquely identify rows. Super Key may have extra attributes; Candidate Key is stripped to minimum.

questions.questionText: निम्न में से किस रिलेशनशिप में जिसमें कोई आंशिक निर्भरता नहीं है, जिसमें सामान्य रूप है?
questions.questionTextEn: Which normal form has no partial dependency?
questions.explanation: 2NF (Second Normal Form) requires: 1) Table is in 1NF, AND 2) No partial dependency (non-prime attributes must be fully functionally dependent on the ENTIRE primary key, not just part of it).

questions.questionText: निम्न में से कौन अनुवर्ती संबंधों की डिग्री नहीं है?
questions.questionTextEn: Which of the following is NOT a degree of relationship?
questions.explanation: Degrees of relationship: Unary (1 entity), Binary (2 entities), Ternary (3 entities), N-ary (N entities). 'Single' is not the standard term; 'Unary' is.

questions.questionText: निम्न में से कौन-सा लॉक जो एक ही तालिका के विभिन्न पंक्तियों तक पहुचने के समवर्ती लेनदेन की अनुमति देता है?
questions.questionTextEn: Which lock allows concurrent transactions to access different rows of the same table?
questions.explanation: Row-level lock allows concurrent transactions to access different rows of the same table, providing maximum concurrency while maintaining consistency.

questions.questionText: एक प्रकार की क्वेरी जो किसी अन्य क्वेरी के WHERE या HAVING क्लॉज के भीतर रखी जाती है उसे कहा जाता है?
questions.questionTextEn: A type of query placed within the WHERE or HAVING clause of another query is called?
questions.explanation: A Sub-query (also called nested query or inner query) is a query placed within the WHERE or HAVING clause of another (outer) query. It executes first and its result is used by the outer query.

questions.questionText: ........ विकास चरण के बजाय, क्वेरी को निष्पादन समय के रूप में दर्ज करने के विकल्प प्रदान करता है?
questions.questionTextEn: _____ provides the option of entering queries at execution time rather than development phase?
questions.explanation: Dynamic SQL allows SQL statements to be constructed and executed at runtime (execution time) rather than being hard-coded during development. This provides flexibility for variable queries.

questions.questionText: एक पंक्ति के लिए RDBMS शब्दावली ___?
questions.questionTextEn: The RDBMS terminology for a row is?
questions.explanation: In RDBMS terminology: Row = Tuple/Record, Column = Attribute/Field, Table = Relation, Set of valid values for column = Domain.

questions.questionText: दो या दो से अधिक गैर-महत्वपूर्ण विशेषताओं के बीच कि एक कार्यात्मक निर्भरता कहा जाता है?
questions.questionTextEn: A functional dependency between two or more non-key attributes is called?
questions.explanation: Transitive dependency occurs when a non-key attribute (A) depends on another non-key attribute (B), which in turn depends on the primary key. A→B→PK creates a transitive dependency, which 3NF eliminates.

questions.questionText: किसी उपयोगकर्ता द्वारा कार्य करने के लिए आवश्यक डेटा के कुछ हिस्सों का तार्किक विवरण कहा जाता है?
questions.questionTextEn: The logical description of some portion of data needed by a user to perform their work is called?
questions.explanation: A User View (or External Schema) is the logical description of the portion of the database that a specific user or application needs. Different users may have different views.

questions.questionText: एक लेनदेन पूरा किया जाता है जिसे ___ कहा जाता है?
questions.questionTextEn: A transaction that has been completed successfully is called?
questions.explanation: A transaction that successfully completes all its operations and permanently saves changes to the database is said to be COMMITTED. If it fails, it is ROLLED BACK.

questions.questionText: निम्न में से किसमें एक रिपोर्ट जेनरेटर का उपयोग किया जाता है?
questions.questionTextEn: In which of the following is a report generator used?
options: उपरोक्त सभी / All of the above
questions.explanation: A Report Generator is specifically used to format and print data in a readable, organized format on paper or as printable documents.

questions.questionText: यदि रिकॉर्ड प्रबंधन प्रणाली डिस्क पर रिकार्ड किए जाने से पहले मानों को संपादित करने की अनुमति देती है, तो आप कर सकते हैं?
questions.questionTextEn: If record management system allows editing values before they are recorded on disk, you can?
options: रिकॉर्ड किए जाने से पहले सही वर्तनी परिवर्तन
questions.explanation: If you can edit values before recording, you can correct spelling errors in the data. Renaming fields and changing field width are structural changes, not data editing.

questions.questionText: प्रत्येक डेटा फाइलों में एक ___ होता है जो फाइल में डेटा संग्रहित करने का तरीका बताता है?
questions.questionTextEn: Each data file has a ___ that describes how data is stored in the file?
questions.explanation: A File Structure defines the organization and format of data within a file — how records are arranged, field order, data types, etc.

questions.questionText: ......में आपके रिकॉर्ड के बाद, कई डेटा प्रबंधन वातावरण के लिए आपको अपने द्वारा किए गए परिवर्तनों को सहेजने के लिए कमाण्ड जारी करने की आवश्यकता होती है?
questions.questionTextEn: After recording, many data management environments require you to issue a command to save changes made — which command?
questions.explanation: UPDATE command is used to save changes made to records in a database table. After modifying data, UPDATE persists those changes.

questions.questionText: अपने उपयोगकर्ताओं को डेटा तक पहुंचने में सहायता के लिए अधिकांश DBMS द्वारा उपयोग की जाने वाली भाषा क्या है?
questions.questionTextEn: What language is used by most DBMS to help users access data?
questions.explanation: SQL (Structured Query Language) is the standard language used by most DBMS for data access, manipulation, and definition.

questions.questionText: द्वितीयक चरण डिवाइस पर संग्रहीत फाइलें डेटा के hierarchy से बनी हैं। फाइल रिकॉर्ड में क्या होता है?
questions.questionTextEn: Files stored on secondary storage devices are made of a hierarchy of data. File records consist of?
questions.explanation: File records consist of Data Fields. Data hierarchy: Bits → Characters/Bytes → Data Fields → Records → Files → Database. A record is a collection of related data fields.

questions.questionText: डेटा प्रबंधन विशेषताओं में कौन-सी डेटा विशेषता शामिल है?
questions.questionTextEn: Which data characteristic is included in data management characteristics?
questions.explanation: In data management, width (field width/length) is a key data characteristic that defines how much data a field can hold. Punctuation, language, and spelling are linguistic properties, not data management characteristics.

questions.questionText: समय-समय पर फाइल रिकॉर्डे जोड़ना, बदलना और हटाने को क्या कहा जाता है?
questions.questionTextEn: Adding, changing, and deleting file records from time to time is called?
questions.explanation: File updating (maintenance) involves three operations: adding records (insertion), changing records (modification), and deleting records (deletion).

questions.questionText: जेनरेटर्स को सॉर्ट/रिपोर्ट करें?
questions.questionTextEn: Sort/Report generators?
options: सूचकांक/रिपोर्ट जेनरेटर से तेज हैं / Faster than index
सूचकांक/रिपोर्ट जेनरेटर की तुलना में अधिक डिस्क स्थान की आवश्यकता है / Require more disk space than index
रिपोर्ट बनाने से पहले क्रमबद्ध करने की आवश्यकता नहीं है
optionsEn: Do not need to sort before creating report
questions.explanation: Sort/Report generators require more disk space because they need to sort the data before generating reports, requiring temporary storage for sorted data.

questions.questionText: CODASYL बिनिर्देशों में एक मालिक-सदस्य सेट हो सकता है?
questions.questionTextEn: In CODASYL specifications, an owner-member set can have?
options: केवल एक मालिक लेकिन कई मालिक घटनाएं
केवल एक सदस्य लेकिन कई सदस्य घटना
एक से अधिक सदस्य लेकिन प्रति सदस्य केवल एक घटन
optionsEn: Only one owner but many owner occurrences
Only one member but many member occurrences
More than one member but only one occurrence per member
questions.explanation: In CODASYL network database model, a SET type has exactly one owner record type but can have multiple member record types. An owner can have many member occurrences (one-to-many).

questions.questionText: SQL में, किस command का उपयोग लेन-देल की शुरुआत के बाद से बयान जारी करने में स्थायी परिवर्तन करने के लिए किया जाता है?
questions.questionTextEn: In SQL, which command makes permanent changes from statements issued since the beginning of a transaction?
questions.explanation: COMMIT permanently saves all changes made during the current transaction. After COMMIT, changes cannot be rolled back. It marks the successful end of a transaction.

questions.questionText: ___ में एक Entity होती है जिसे Root कहा जाता है?
questions.questionTextEn: ___ has an Entity called Root?
questions.explanation: In the Hierarchical Model, the tree structure has a single topmost entity called the ROOT. All other entities are children/descendants of the root in a parent-child hierarchy.

questions.questionText: Storage Manager में Data को जल्दी अर्थात् तत्परता से प्राप्त करने हेतु ___ प्रयुक्त होता है?
questions.questionTextEn: What is used in Storage Manager for quick/fast data retrieval?
questions.explanation: Indices (Index structures like B-trees, Hash indexes) are used by the Storage Manager for fast data retrieval. Indices allow direct access to records without scanning entire files.

questions.questionText: निम्न में से कौन-सा Query Processor का Element है?
questions.questionTextEn: Which of the following is an element of the Query Processor?
questions.explanation: The Query Processor includes DDL interpreter, DML compiler/interpreter, and Query Evaluation Engine. Together they parse, optimize, and execute queries.

questions.questionText: Relation में Tuples की कुल संख्या कहलाती है?
questions.questionTextEn: The total number of Tuples in a Relation is called?
questions.explanation: Cardinality = total number of tuples (rows) in a relation. Degree = total number of attributes (columns). These are two important measures of a relation.

questions.questionText: DBMS में Attributes की कुल संख्या कहलाती है ___?
questions.questionTextEn: The total number of Attributes in DBMS is called?
options: रिलेशन की डिग्री / Degree of the relation
रिलेशन का संबंध / Relation of the relation
रिलेशन का कोड / Code of the relation
questions.explanation: Degree of a Relation = total number of attributes (columns). Cardinality = total number of tuples (rows). These are fundamental relational database concepts.

questions.questionText: किस Key हेतु चुना गया Field NULL Value स्वीकार नहीं कर सकता?
questions.questionTextEn: The field chosen for which key CANNOT accept NULL values?
questions.explanation: Primary Key has two properties: NOT NULL and UNIQUE. It cannot ever be NULL. Unique Key only ensures uniqueness but ALLOWS null values.

questions.questionText: Relational Database में दो सारणियों के बीच Link प्रदान करती है?
questions.questionTextEn: What provides a link between two tables in a Relational Database?
questions.explanation: Foreign Key provides the link/relationship between two tables. It references the Primary Key of another table to establish referential integrity.

questions.questionText: RDBMS के सम्बन्ध में true statement है?
questions.questionTextEn: Which is a true statement about RDBMS?
options: यह Relational प्रकार का DBMS है / It is a Relational type of DBMS
RDBMS, DBMS का advance version है / RDBMS is an advanced version of DBMS
RDBMS में प्रत्येक Table दूसरी Table से संबंध बनाए रखती है / Each table maintains relationship with other tables
questions.explanation: All three statements are true: RDBMS is a relational DBMS, it's an advanced version of DBMS with additional relational features, and it maintains relationships between tables via foreign keys.

questions.questionText: E-R Diagram में Entity को दर्शित करने हेतु प्रयुक्त होता है?
questions.questionTextEn: What is used to represent an Entity in an E-R Diagram?
questions.explanation: In ER Diagram: Rectangle = Entity (strong), Double Rectangle = Weak Entity, Diamond = Relationship, Ellipse/Circle = Attribute, Diamond = Relationship type.

questions.questionText: Entity सेट में एक Entity का समान प्रकार की दूसरी Entity से अन्तर करने हेतु प्रयुक्त होता है?
questions.questionTextEn: What is used to distinguish one entity from another entity of the same type in an entity set?
questions.explanation: Attributes (specifically key attributes/primary key) are used to distinguish one entity from another of the same type. Each entity has unique attribute values.

questions.questionText: E-R डायग्राम में प्रयुक्त Entity का प्रकार है?
questions.questionTextEn: What type of Entity is used in an E-R diagram?
questions.explanation: ER Diagrams use both Weak Entities (without own primary key) and Strong Entities (with own primary key). Both types are fundamental to ER modeling.

questions.questionText: Weak Entity को दर्शाने हेतु प्रयुक्त होता है?
questions.questionTextEn: What is used to represent a Weak Entity?
questions.explanation: Weak Entity is represented by a Double Rectangle (also called Bold/thick rectangle) in ER diagrams. Strong Entity = single rectangle.

questions.questionText: Weak Entity किस पर निर्भर करती है?
questions.questionTextEn: Weak Entity depends on?
questions.explanation: A Weak Entity depends on its Parent/Owner (Strong) Entity for identification. It cannot exist independently and uses the parent entity's primary key combined with its own partial key.

questions.questionText: DBMS के अन्तर्गत entities के मध्य relationship दर्शाने हेतु प्रयुक्त Model है?
questions.questionTextEn: Which Model is used to show relationships between entities in DBMS?
questions.explanation: The E-R Model (Entity Relationship Model) is used to show relationships between entities. options (a) and (c) refer to the same model.

questions.questionText: E-R Model के main component है?
questions.questionTextEn: What are the main components of E-R Model?
questions.explanation: The three main components of E-R Model are: Entities (represented by rectangles), Attributes (represented by ellipses), and Relationships (represented by diamonds).

questions.questionText: Entity के मध्य Relationship किसके द्वारा दर्शायी जाती है?
questions.questionTextEn: How is Relationship between Entities shown?
questions.explanation: In ER Diagrams, Relationships between entities are represented by Diamonds (rhombus shapes). Rectangles = Entities, Ellipses/Circles = Attributes.

questions.questionText: एक Entity की Property को describe करने हेतु प्रयुक्त होता है?
questions.questionTextEn: What is used to describe a Property of an Entity?
questions.explanation: An Attribute describes a property/characteristic of an entity. For example, Student entity has attributes: Name, Age, Roll Number, etc.

questions.questionText: Abstraction का highest level है?
questions.questionTextEn: What is the highest level of Abstraction?
questions.explanation: Three levels of abstraction (from highest to lowest): External/View Level (highest) → Conceptual/Logical Level → Internal/Physical Level (lowest). External Schema = highest level = what users see.

questions.questionText: Database Life Cycle के Step हैं?
questions.questionTextEn: What are the steps of Database Life Cycle?
questions.explanation: Database Life Cycle includes: Requirements Analysis → Design → Implementation → Testing → Operation & Maintenance → Evolution. All given steps are part of the DBLC.

questions.questionText: Stack को कहा जाता है?
questions.questionTextEn: Stack is called?
questions.explanation: Stack follows LIFO = Last In First Out, which is equivalent to FILO = First In Last Out. Both describe the same behavior. FIFO = Queue. Stack = LIFO = FILO.

questions.questionText: एक टेबल जो डाटा रिडेन्डेन्सी जैसी विसंगतियाँ प्रदर्शित करती है-
questions.questionTextEn: A table that exhibits anomalies like data redundancy is subject to?
questions.explanation: Data redundancy leads to three types of anomalies: Update Anomaly (changing data in one place doesn't update all), Insertion Anomaly (can't add data without other data), Deletion Anomaly (deleting data removes other needed data).

questions.questionText: एक क्वेरी का प्रकार जो किसी अन्य Query के WHERE या HAVING clause में रखी जाती है, कहलाता है?
questions.questionTextEn: A type of query placed inside the WHERE or HAVING clause of another query is called?
questions.explanation: Sub-query (nested query) is placed within the WHERE or HAVING clause of another (outer) query. Same as Q71.

questions.questionText: एक ट्रांजिशन पूर्ण होने पर इसका execution कहलाता है?
questions.questionTextEn: When a transaction completes successfully, its execution is called?
questions.explanation: A successfully completed transaction is COMMITTED. An unsuccessful transaction is ABORTED/ROLLED BACK. Failed = aborted transaction.

questions.questionText: DCL ......... की तरह कार्य करने की कमाण्ड उपलब्ध कराता है?
questions.questionTextEn: DCL provides commands to work like?
options: Insert, Update or Delete Records And Data Values
Authorizing Access and Other Control Over Database
questions.explanation: DCL = Data Control Language. It controls access to database. Commands: GRANT (give privileges) and REVOKE (remove privileges). DCL is for authorization and access control.

questions.questionText: एक डेटाबेस में आपको डाटा को एक्सेस या मैन्टेन करने की अनुमति प्रदान करने वाली Language है?
questions.questionTextEn: Which language in a database provides permission to access or maintain data?
questions.explanation: DCL (Data Control Language) provides commands (GRANT, REVOKE) to control access permissions for database users.

questions.questionText: निम्न में से कौनसा की-वर्ड Data Control Language (DCL) में प्रयुक्त होता है?
questions.questionTextEn: Which keyword is used in Data Control Language (DCL)?
questions.explanation: GRANT is a DCL command that gives privileges to users. SELECT, INSERT, DELETE are DML commands. GRANT and REVOKE are the two main DCL commands.

questions.questionText: ..... Clause एक एडिशनल फिल्टर है जो किसी Result पर apply किया जाता है?
questions.questionTextEn: _____ Clause is an additional filter applied on a Result?
questions.explanation: HAVING clause is an additional filter applied to GROUP BY results. WHERE filters rows before grouping; HAVING filters groups after grouping. Same as Q38.
